name: yannikzz
description: 把界面约定写成规范再写代码：区域树、视觉 token、线框与体检，一套可被 agent 执行的 UI 契约方法。

plugins.name: ui-contract
plugins.description: Establishes a project's UI contract: a structural spec with a placement decision tree and a region-name allowlist, a visual spec whose values live in the token file, an asset layer in the production tree, a runnable low-fidelity wireframe, enforcement that stops coding agents putting new features in the wrong place, and a health check that reports drift months later.
